metadata.description: Canonical CS ontology entries for algorithmic concepts taught in undergraduate CS courses.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A class of algorithms that arrange elements of a list in a certain order (ascending or descending).

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A search algorithm that finds the position of a target value within a sorted array in O(log n) time.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A sequential search algorithm that checks each element until a match is found or the list ends.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A graph traversal algorithm that explores as far as possible along each branch before backtracking.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A graph traversal algorithm that explores all neighbours at the present depth before moving to nodes at the next depth level.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm with O(n log n) time complexity.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm with average O(n log n) time complexity, uses a pivot element.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A simple sorting algorithm that repeatedly steps through the list, compares adjacent elements and swaps them if out of order.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A simple sorting algorithm that builds the final sorted array one item at a time.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A sorting algorithm that divides input into sorted and unsorted regions and repeatedly selects the minimum element.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A comparison-based sorting algorithm that uses a binary heap data structure.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A non-comparison-based integer sorting algorithm that counts element occurrences.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A distribution-based sorting algorithm that distributes elements into buckets.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A non-comparative integer sorting algorithm that sorts by individual digits.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: Algorithms that operate on graph data structures, including traversal, shortest path, and spanning tree algorithms.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A greedy algorithm that finds the shortest path from a single source to all other vertices in a weighted graph.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A best-first search algorithm that uses a heuristic to find the shortest path efficiently.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A shortest-path algorithm that handles graphs with negative edge weights.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.category: Algorithms > Graph > All Pairs Shortest Path
entries.definition: A dynamic programming algorithm for finding shortest paths between all pairs of vertices.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A greedy algorithm that finds a minimum spanning tree by adding edges in increasing weight order.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A greedy algorithm that builds a minimum spanning tree by repeatedly adding the cheapest edge.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A linear ordering of vertices in a directed acyclic graph such that for every directed edge u→v, u appears before v.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: An algorithmic paradigm that solves complex problems by breaking them into overlapping subproblems and storing results.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: An algorithmic paradigm that makes the locally optimal choice at each step hoping for a global optimum.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: An algorithm design paradigm that divides a problem into smaller subproblems, solves them recursively, and combines results.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: An algorithmic technique that considers all possible combinations and backtracks when a solution path fails.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A method of solving problems where the solution depends on solutions to smaller instances of the same problem.

entries.label: ALGORITHM
entries.definition: A straightforward approach to solving a problem by trying all possible solutions.
